notes.title: 🎮 A Game Born in War
notes.content:
[p]Hi there! 👋[/p][p]A year ago, I started working on an idea — to create a world where the player chooses between good and evil, light and darkness.
This is not just fantasy — the game reflects the [b]history of Ukraine and the strength of the Ukrainian people[/b], their struggle and hope even in the darkest times.[/p][p]I’m developing the game alone.[/p][p]At first, I planned to release it on [b]24.02.2025[/b], then moved it to [b]25.04.2025[/b], but due to technical issues, lack of experience, and the difficult situation in Ukraine, I had to postpone.
👉 [b]Updated plan:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]November 2025[/b] — Alpha release.[/p][/*][*][p][b]25.08.2026[/b], Ukraine’s Independence Day — Full release.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]💡 [b]What players can expect[/b][/p][list][*][p]A living world where every choice between light and darkness matters.[/p][/*][*][p]Atmospheric Ukrainian-inspired locations: fields, rivers, villages, shrines.[/p][/*][*][p]Quests and stories connected to culture and struggle.[/p][/*][*][p]Heroes and antagonists with their own stories and motivations.[/p][/*][*][p]A storyline that reflects the resilience of the Ukrainian people.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🤝 [b]How you can support[/b][/p][list][*][p]Add the game to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b] (important for visibility).[/p][/*][*][p]Purchase the [b]Alpha[/b] once it’s out — this is the main way to support development.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🙌 [b]Thank you[/b]
Your support will help bring this project to full release and share with the world a story about light and darkness, about Ukraine, and about a people who always fight and always find the path to Light.[/p]

notes.title: 📢 New NPC!
notes.content:
Hello, players! We're excited to share details about the new characters you'll encounter in our game. Each one has a unique story that will make your experience even more captivating. Let's meet the new heroes:

Blacksmith: Victor 🔥
Description: Victor showed his dangerous nature at the young age of four. He doesn’t remember the day when his small hands first stumbled upon a bit of sulfur, metal shavings, and acid from his father’s forge. Since then, explosions, flashes, and the indignant screams of neighbors have been part of his daily life. Over the years, his inventions became more complex: from semi-mechanical shovels to washing machines for the entire village. Eventually, Victor earned the love and respect of the community with his skill in creating weapons and tools. His creations are known throughout the land. Victor is a master who’s dangerous and unpredictable, with hands of gold and a mind full of astonishing ideas.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838586/023e82c8ab3920ca760816f24be2cfdaf3b5eb27.gif[/img]

Merchant: Marco 🚶
Description: Marco is a traveler, always on the move. He never feared crossing the unknown boundaries, often journeying without a map and always returning with amazing things and knowledge. Languages were his key to new discoveries and trade. When he returned home, he brought with him the scents of distant lands, a sun-kissed face, and a smile of someone who had found his place. But now his travels have ended. The roads he once walked are now filled with destruction and the Horde.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838586/8cd66eab842a5b0b007458ae277c6e3907541623.gif[/img]

Katya 😰
Description: Katya is a symbol of how war changes people. From the first day, she has not stopped crying, begging for rescue. Her psyche cannot endure what’s happening around her, and she’s willing to do anything for her peace of mind. War does not choose its victims, and it struck Katya especially deeply. Her fear and desire for safety serve as a reminder of the mercilessness of war.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838586/aed8e49ee6a2cd7f06d7542b71ec8f880356a45d.gif[/img]

Nurse: Lisa ⚕️
Description: Lisa was always first, and so she was called. Top of her kindergarten class, first in her medical academy, she quickly learned the harsh reality: abuse, ruthless dissections, and experiments on captives. Not for science – just because it was fun. She easily mastered “helping” members of the Horde: disinfectant, bandages, and if that didn’t help, a final blow. Lisa is a person who found her path in the darkness and doesn’t hesitate to walk it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838586/deceb1ba61f20659516bb6e69232ac8b1a64b205.gif[/img]

Each of these characters adds their own unique story to the game world. We hope you're excited to learn more about their fates and the impact they’ll have on the game world.

notes.title: New locations in game
notes.content:
[b]Hello, players![/b]

We’re excited to bring you an update on our game’s development. We’ve just finished working on several new locations, and they’re looking absolutely stunning!

Take a look at the screenshots of these newly created environments and immerse yourself in the virtual worlds awaiting you. Here are some of the highlights:

[list]
[*] Ethnic Landscapes: Fields, rivers, lush vegetation, and serene beaches.
[*] Detailed and Lively Locations: Each place is filled with unique elements—plants, characters, and puzzles to uncover.
[*] Atmospheric Interiors: Every building tells a story, with its own unique style and history.
[*] These locations are not only visually captivating but also rich with stories about the people, their lives, and the challenges they face. New mysteries and quests are waiting for you to discover.
[/list]

What will the future hold for these lands? A rebirth full of color and life, or a silent, black-and-white wasteland?

Check out the screenshots and share your thoughts in the comments!
[b]
Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more updates and news![/b]

notes.title: 24: Demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We want announce that the demo for my game, "24," is now live and available for you to try on both Windows and Mac! Six months ago, I began this journey to create a game that shares the powerful and poignant stories of Ukrainians, our rich history, and the ongoing Ukrainian/Russian war. "24" is a tribute to the lives affected by the conflict, honoring those who have perished, and shedding light on significant historical tragedy such as the Holodomor.

Despite the challenges, we are passionate about this project and hope it resonates with you. The demo is now available and we would love for you to check it out and share your feedback.


Thank you for your support and for helping us bring this story to life!

notes.title: Introducing 24: The Malevolent Doctor of the Order
notes.content:
In the shadowy alleys of the Order's domain, whispers abound of a figure both feared and revered—a figure known only as Steam. Renowned for his surgical precision and sadistic delights, Steam embodies the darkest facets of the Order's ethos.

Originating from humble beginnings, Steam's path to infamy was paved with the twisted teachings of the Order. By the tender age of 16, what was once an innocuous child had metamorphosed into a sinister practitioner, gleefully conducting surgeries without the mercy of anesthesia, often on hapless prisoners or those deemed expendable by the Order's hierarchy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838586/ddc72786718deee59c4f06d1bfb2252b22316696.gif[/img]


Yet, it wasn't merely the absence of compassion that set Steam apart, but his unnerving demeanor—a smile that bespoke both malice and amusement, and a penchant for morbid humor that sent shivers down the spines of even the most hardened denizens of the Order.

His macabre talents did not go unnoticed within the ranks of the Order; rather, they were celebrated. For in a realm where power is measured by one's capacity for cruelty, Steam's insatiable thirst for blood and suffering elevated him to a position of prestige within the Order's hierarchy.

As whispers of his exploits spread like wildfire among the populace, so too did his legend grow—a cautionary tale of the depths to which one could sink under the malevolent influence of the Order.

In the annals of the Order's history, Steam stands as a chilling reminder of the darkness that lurks within its hallowed halls—a darkness that, once unleashed, knows no bounds.
